# kc.toml Configuration Writer

Generates a template-based kc.toml configuration file with interpolated repository-specific values and writes it to the repository directory. This provides the foundational configuration that controls plugin activation, publishing, semantic features, and integrations for the repository.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.write_config`
